name_en: Gawa — a chilled miso soup of raw bonito, cucumber, and pickled plum
summary_ja: 生のカツオをたたき、きゅうりや梅干し、青しそとともに味噌で溶いた冷たい汁。カツオ漁に出た漁師が船上で氷水に味噌を溶くとき「ガワガワ」と音がしたことが名の由来と伝わる、夏の漁師めしだったとされる。
summary_en: Raw bonito is minced and mixed into a chilled miso broth with cucumber, pickled plum, and shiso. Its name is said to come from the "gawa-gawa" sound of stirring miso into ice water aboard a fishing boat — originally a summer meal made at sea.
source_title: がわ 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Tororo jiru — grated mountain yam soup poured over barley rice
summary_ja: すりおろした自然薯をだし汁と味噌でのばし、麦飯にかけて食べる。東海道の宿場町だった丸子（現・静岡市駿河区）の名物で、十返舎一九や松尾芭蕉の作にも登場するほど古くから旅人に親しまれてきたとされる。
summary_en: Grated wild mountain yam is thinned with dashi and miso, then poured over barley rice. A specialty of the old Tokaido post town of Marico, in present-day Shizuoka, it's said to appear in Jippensha Ikku's travel novel and a Basho haiku, once favored by travelers on the road.
source_title: とろろ汁 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ozaku — a simmered vegetable soup of taro, daikon, and carrot
summary_ja: 里芋や大根、にんじんなどをだし汁と醤油、砂糖でざくざくと切って煮る汁物。結婚式や葬式など人が集まるとき、近所がそれぞれの畑の野菜を持ち寄ってつくった料理と伝わる。
summary_en: Taro, daikon, and carrot are roughly chopped and simmered in dashi with soy sauce and sugar. Said to have been made for weddings, funerals, and other gatherings, with neighbors each bringing vegetables from their own fields.
source_title: おざく 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Shizuoka oden — oden simmered in a broth blackened with dark fish cake and beef tendon
summary_ja: 牛すじや黒はんぺん、練り物、大根、卵を串に刺し、色の黒いだし汁で煮込んで青のりとだし粉をかける。戦後、捨てられていた牛すじや豚モツを具にしたことで人気が高まったと伝わる、静岡市の郷土おでん。
summary_en: Beef tendon, dark fish cake, fish cakes, daikon, and egg are skewered and simmered in a broth cooked nearly black, then dusted with green laver and dried fish powder. Popularity is said to have grown after the war, when once-discarded beef tendon and offal became a filling.
source_title: 静岡おでん 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Tamago fuwafuwa — a whipped egg poured into clear broth until airy
summary_ja: 卵とだし汁だけでつくる、ふわりと泡立てた食感のすまし汁。江戸時代の紀行文「仙台下向日記」に、袋井宿の本陣で宿泊客の朝食に出されたという記述が残ると伝わり、観光協会が再現・復活させたとされる。
summary_en: Made from nothing but egg and dashi, this clear soup is whipped into a soft, foamy texture. A travel diary from the Edo period is said to record it being served for breakfast at the Fukuroi post town's main inn, later revived by the local tourism association.
source_title: たまごふわふわ 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
